layout.arrangement: Two-line bold title centered at top with red-highlighted math tokens; yellow slide-number badge at top-right. Below, ONE large peach rounded panel fills almost the whole slide and contains a single wide left-to-right dataflow diagram: far-left encoder-output group (hatched box + yellow Y-container + green W_k boxes + striped K boxes), center-left gray 'Dot Product' box with blue dots and red mesh, center pink 'Scaling by √d' column and violet 'Soft max' column (both with vertical text), center-right column of red × multiplier nodes feeding a light-blue Σ box with green 'O' output box above, far-right mirrored encoder-output group (yellow Y-container + blue W_v boxes + V labels + hatched box). Bottom strip: pink container with Z₁–Z₄ (Z₂ highlighted) with a thick red up-arrow, W_q/q₂ query below it, magenta caption 'From Decoder Self Attention Layer' with white left-pointing 3D arrow, and a pale-green matrix-dimension legend at bottom-right.

layout.hierarchy: The peach diagram panel dominates the slide. Title is the largest/boldest text (black with red spans). Red is the attention-grabbing color: all math-entity labels (K, V, Y, q, Z), arrows, fraction, and highlights are red. Yellow containers/pills act as secondary anchors; small black bold text inside colored boxes is tertiary; vertical column captions are mid-weight.

visual_elements.description: Encoder-decoder cross-attention dataflow, left to right. (1) LEFT INPUT: red 3D block arrow at slide edge (pointing outward-left); hatched rectangle 'From Encoder Output' (red bold text, white center, red diagonal-hatch side panels); below it a yellow rounded container with dashed green border holding 4 rows (top→bottom Y₄, Y₃, Y₂, Y₁), each row a yellow strip of ~4 small white cells with the red Y-label in the first cell; black right-arrows from each row into green boxes 'W_k^(r)'; black right-arrows into small vertically-striped (white/pale-yellow) boxes labeled K₄, K₃, K₂, K₁ in red. (2) DOT PRODUCT: thin lines from all K boxes converge into a tall gray-tan box titled 'Dot Product' containing 4 blue dots joined by a mesh of thin red lines; a thin line also enters from below from q₂; yellow pill 'Similarity' floats above-left; red 'K.q' label at top-right exit. (3) SCALING: red fraction K.q over √d above a tall pink column with bottom-to-top vertical text 'Scaling by √d'. (4) SOFTMAX: adjacent tall violet column with vertical text 'Soft max'; yellow pill 'Probabilities' above. (5) WEIGHTED SUM: four small circles with red '×' stacked vertically receive lines from Soft max on the left and lines labeled V₄, V₃, V₂, V₁ from the right; those V lines originate at blue boxes 'W_v^(r)' which receive black left-arrows from a mirrored yellow Y-container (Y₄…Y₁) fed by a second hatched 'From Encoder Output' box with a red 3D block arrow pointing outward-right at the slide edge; each × output rises into a light-blue rectangle with a large black 'Σ'; yellow pill 'Weighted SUM' above; thick green arrow points up from Σ to a green box 'O' flanked by small striped vector cells. (6) DECODER QUERY (bottom): pink rounded container with four striped cells Z₁, Z₂, Z₃, Z₄ (Z₂ highlighted with red dashed border); thick red 3D arrow points up at Z₂; below it red 'q₂' with a small striped vector glyph and a white box 'W_q^(r)'; magenta caption 'From Decoder Self Attention Layer' with a white 3D arrow pointing left toward the Z-row.

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Tahoma-like). Title: bold, ~24pt, centered, two-tone black/red. Subtitle line: bold, slightly smaller (~16–18pt), also black with red math tokens. Diagram labels: bold, small (~9–12pt); 'Scaling by √d' and 'Soft max' are rotated 90° (bottom-to-top vertical text) inside their tall columns. Subscripts used for indices (K₄…K₁, V₄…V₁, Y₁…Y₄, Z₁…Z₄, q₂) and small superscripts '(r)' on weight matrices W_k, W_v, W_q. Yellow pill callouts (Similarity, Probabilities, Weighted SUM) use bold black text. 'Weighted SUM' uses all-caps 'SUM'. No numbered bullets anywhere; this is a full-slide diagram.
